notes: Spectrum X (branded "VSX2" in the current datasheet) is a modular, software-licensed broadcast media server, not a fixed-port device — exact SDI channel/port function is field-configurable (Standard/Enhanced/UHD channel mode), and several IP ports are optional add-in modules rather than standard-fit. Data reflects the 1RU chassis variant; a 2RU variant exists with different Ethernet mix (four 1GE mgmt instead of 10GE), optional 25GE SMPTE 2110 I/O, and UHD 12G-SDI support that the 1RU chassis does not carry (1RU tops out at 3G-SDI per the datasheet's raster table). SDI/reference/AES/LTC connectors are documented in the installation manual as DIN 1.0/2.3 mini-coax reached via an SDI/Reference breakout cable off a 60-pin DSUB card connector — mapped to "bnc" as the closest listed connector id since DIN 1.0/2.3 isn't in the enum. GPIO and PSU inlet exact connector shapes were not explicitly stated in the sources reviewed and are best-guess closest matches. Port-level detail was cross-checked against the official Harmonic installation manual as hosted on ManualsLib (manufacturer content, third-party host) since Harmonic's own site does not publish the full installation manual for public download.

ports.name: I/O 1 (Ext. Input 1 / Key 1)
ports.note: Standard Channel Mode. Actual connector is DIN 1.0/2.3 mini-coax, not full-size BNC — closest listed connector used.

ports.name: I/O 8 (Output, Secondary)
ports.note: DIN 1.0/2.3 mini-coax. All 8 SDI I/O connectors are on a single card breaking out from a 60-pin DSUB via SDI breakout cable; function per position is field-configurable and channel-mode-dependent.

ports.name: Reference In
ports.note: Analog black burst / reference input, part of Reference Breakout Cable off the DSUB-60 connector.

ports.name: MF1 (Ch A AES/LTC In)
ports.note: Combined-function breakout lead: wired for either AES3 audio in or LTC in per Standard Channel Mode. Physical connector style unconfirmed beyond 'multi-function I/O' coax lead.

ports.name: RS-422
ports.note: Automation/VDCP control (Polaris Play, Oxtel protocol, VDCP), broken out from DSUB-60.

ports.name: GPIO
ports.note: General-purpose tally/relay I/O broken out from DSUB-60; exact physical connector style on the adapter cable unconfirmed — euroblock chosen as closest terminal-style match.

ports.name: 10GbE Mgmt 1
ports.note: One of four fixed 10GE ports (1RU chassis) for SystemManager, file transfer, and API control.

ports.name: Server Interface (GbE)
ports.note: Private, point-to-point, non-switchable gigabit Ethernet link to a MediaDirector or MediaCenter server.

ports.name: IP I/O 1 (NDI, 10GE)
ports.note: Optional add-in module — one of dual 10GE ports for NDI I/O. Copper vs SFP+ fiber not confirmed in public docs.

ports.name: IP I/O 1 (MediaGrid, 10GE)
ports.note: Optional add-in module — dual 10GE ports for Ingest/Play from Harmonic MediaGrid.

ports.name: Power Supply 1
ports.note: Dual, redundant, hot-swappable PSU (1 of 2). 1RU rated 550W typical / 800W max. Exact IEC inlet variant (C13/C14 vs C19/C20) not stated in public docs.
